scripts.build: tsc -b packages/wire-contracts packages/canonical packages/temporal packages/schema packages/core packages/exchange packages/application apps/cli
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/wire-contracts packages/canonical packages/temporal packages/schema packages/core packages/exchange packages/application apps/cli --pretty false
scripts.verify:contracts: pnpm build && node apps/cli/dist/main.js contract-kit verify wmm-v0.3-contract-kit
scripts.verify:v0: pnpm build && node apps/cli/dist/main.js v0 verify wmm-v0.3-contract-kit fixtures/v0/semantic-contract-cases.json
scripts.verify:seed: pnpm build && node apps/cli/dist/main.js seed validate wmm-v0.3-contract-kit
scripts.generate:fixtures: pnpm build && node tools/generate-v1-fixture.mjs && node tools/generate-v2-fixtures.mjs
scripts.verify:v1: pnpm build && node apps/cli/dist/main.js json < fixtures/v1/validate-request.json
scripts.verify:v2: pnpm build && node apps/cli/dist/main.js json < fixtures/v2/query-request.json && node apps/cli/dist/main.js json < fixtures/v2/absence-request.json && node apps/cli/dist/main.js json < fixtures/v2/interval-request.json
scripts.check: pnpm verify:kit && pnpm typecheck:tests && pnpm test
